description: Displays switched during saccades, when no retinal signal reaches visual cortex, often went unnoticed, including a switch between red and green at the center of a display (Grimes 1996, as reported by Rosenthal).
limitations: Reported secondhand. The original study is not among the sources read. Block disputes that subjects keep seeing the old color.

sources.quote: Participants often were not consciously aware of changes in salient visual features
